_comment2: dossierSections pulls the named sections of /llms-full.txt into that page's Markdown. The brands page shows its portfolio as logo images only, so without this the brand names and descriptions would be missing from the text a reader gets.
_comment: Single source of truth for which English pages get a clean Markdown counterpart at <path>.md. Read by src/app/llms.txt/route.ts (to advertise them) and by scripts/generate-md.mjs (to write them). Legal pages and individual blog posts are deliberately absent: legal text is not useful to assistants, and blog posts are generated from their own Markdown source instead.
